title: Race Result Finish Time Goal Adherence by Event
dataSources: Race results (`raceresult:event`), TrainingPeaks workouts (`trainingpeaks:workout`), marathon splits (`race:split`), bib pickup and race logistics (`race:bib`).
app: Race result APIs, TrainingPeaks workouts and TSS, marathon split exports, and bib-collection checklists streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted REST inputs, CSV imports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=raceresult:event
| stats avg(finish_time_min) as actual count as sessions by event_name
| eval pct_of_goal=round(100*240.0/actual,1), goal_label="240"
| sort pct_of_goal
description: Compares average finish time in minutes with a simple target for each event, showing where race result finish time is meeting plan and where it is lagging.
value: Splitting target adherence by event shows which contexts are helping you hit the plan and which ones need adjustment.
implementation: Set the target value in the query to match your routine, then review low-adherence event values before the next session block.
visualization: Table of event values with average finish time in minutes and percent of goal.
grandmaExplanation: It counts which event settings help you hit your target for race result finish time and which ones fall short.
